title: A quick but engaging tour of the beautiful Alcázar!
text:
We were very lucky that Isabel had an availability to guide us that day as most tours were fully booked and Isabel had been recommended by her colleague. It was wonderful getting to discover the Alcázar, and we learned so much about the history of the palace, its rooms, and construction even in the short time our quick day trip to Sevilla could afford. It was really cool seeing all the filming locations for Game of Thrones pointed out, and Isabel was kind enough to send a video compilation of these locations even after our tour.

title: An exceptional monument, it deserves a guide at the same height. Isabel, it is.
text:
Something as dazzling and exceptional as el.alcazar deserves to visit with a person like Isabel, who fills you with history, anecdotes and immerses you inside the Alcazar, so that you can not only marvel at the art, but also be able to almost live the centuries of history that have traveled its rooms and gardens.
A quality visit, you need a quality guide. 100% recommended.

text: We were recently with the family and children. Lovely place, magical city and unsurpassed guide. We will definitely repeat with her for other tours in future visits. Thank you for making our visit to the Alcazares so special.
author: Maria G

title: Isobel is a fantastic Guide
text: We booked Isobel as a private guide in Seville. How lucky we were! She is thoughtful, informative and supremely knowledgeable. Her knowledge is no limited to just the sights of the Alcazar etc, her intelligence shines through as she relates questions to wider historical worldwide events. Importantly she is just lovely and genuine. We enjoyed our time with her as she coped with informed questions and we shared so many smiles and humour our moments as we traversed through this wonderful place. I cannot recommend her enough.
author: sunnyside_judy

title: Reales Alcázares Guided Tour
text: Coworkers we meet to get out of the routine to visit the Royal Alcazars with Isabel. We were impressed with the ease and fluidity of their explanations, with practical examples of what was happening in each room. If we had gone alone for us we would not have enjoyed and learned so much. Super friendly, simple and involved in your work.
